# FreeHosts — Free Hosting Directory
> https://freehosts.eu

## About
FreeHosts is a community-curated directory of free hosting providers for websites, Discord bots, applications, and databases.

## Structured data
All pages use JSON-LD schema.org markup including WebSite, WebPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, ItemList, and Service types.
